content.short: Juice Finance is a cross-margin DeFi protocol on Blast designed to maximize leveraged yield and reward farming.
content.description: Juice Finance is a high-performance cross-margin DeFi protocol built natively on the Blast Layer 2 network. It is specifically engineered to maximize capital efficiency for users by providing leveraged yield farming opportunities. Borrowers can access up to 3x leverage on collateral to deploy into a curated selection of vetted Blast dApps, significantly amplifying potential returns. Deeply integrated with Blast, Juice Finance is optimized to help users accumulate points and rewards while providing a seamless, professional experience through a robust liquidation and execution framework.
content.meta: Juice Finance provides leveraged yield farming and reward optimization on Blast. Discover Juice and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
